config.title: FUNDA — Breadcrumb Navigator

intro.title: FUNDA — Breadcrumb Navigator
intro.body: In this lesson you will build a Breadcrumb Navigator — an automatically generated trail that reflects the current route hierarchy (Home → Products → Electronics → Laptops) with each segment being a clickable link. The breadcrumbs update dynamically as the user navigates without manual configuration per page. You will listen to the Router's NavigationEnd events, walk the ActivatedRoute tree to collect route data.breadcrumb values, and render them as a reactive list.
intro.usecase: Breadcrumbs are a UX staple in e-commerce category pages, file managers, CMS admin panels, settings hierarchies, and multi-level data drill-downs. The automatic-generation approach demonstrates architectural thinking: data-driven, DRY, and maintainable as the route tree grows.

objectives: Inject the Router and subscribe to its events stream, filtering for NavigationEnd events using the filter() and instanceof operators
Traverse the ActivatedRoute tree from root to the deepest child, collecting route.data.breadcrumb values at each level
Attach breadcrumb data (label and optional icon) to each route definition in the route configuration array
Build the breadcrumb array as an Observable and render it using the async pipe with an *ngFor loop
Apply routerLink to each breadcrumb segment so clicking navigates to that ancestor route
Handle dynamic route segments (e.g., a product name from route params) by resolving the label from the ActivatedRoute snapshot
Use structured JSON-LD schema markup in the breadcrumb template for SEO-correct rich results in Google Search
